provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: Puts a noun (or a plain clause) up front as the yardstick the rest of the sentence is judged against: 素人にしちゃ frames everything that follows as an amateur-scale assessment, usually an approving one. Class sibling としちゃ sets the same kind of yardstick flatly and objectively (相撲取りとしては小柄だ, simply below the norm), whereas にしちゃ colors the assessment with mild 意外性. When the clash with expectation is itself the point of the sentence rather than the frame — the 'and yet' reading that pairs with くせして and わりに — the corpus files the identical string in the 逆接-想外 class instead. にしちゃ is the casual spoken squeeze of にしては and stays out of formal writing.

examples.ruby: 素人[しろうと]にしちゃ、ずいぶん思[おも]い切[き]った攻[せ]め方[かた]だな。
examples.english: That's a remarkably bold line of attack for an amateur.

examples.ruby: この値段[ねだん]にしちゃ、味[あじ]はなかなかのものだ。
examples.english: For what it costs, the taste is honestly pretty good.

examples.ruby: うちの犬[いぬ]はチワワにしちゃ、よく食[た]べるほうだ。
examples.english: For a chihuahua, ours puts away a fair amount of food.

patterns.usage_note: Names the class the subject is being measured in, so the judgment that follows is relative to that class and not to things in general: 国産としちゃ高い prices the watch against domestic watches only. Class sibling にしちゃ sets up the same kind of yardstick but adds a note of surprise, while としちゃ stays flat and evaluative. The identical string also carries a standpoint reading filed in the 観点 class (俺としちゃ賛成だ, 'speaking for myself'); there the noun is the person whose opinion it is, here it is the category the subject belongs to. としては is the everyday realization, としましては the business-polite one, としちゃ the casual squeeze.

examples.ruby: この時計[とけい]は国産[こくさん]としちゃ、かなり値段[ねだん]が張[は]るな。
examples.english: As domestic watches go, this one carries a pretty steep price.

examples.ruby: ここは都心[としん]のワンルームとしちゃ広[ひろ]いほうだ。
examples.english: For a downtown studio apartment, this place is on the roomy side.

examples.ruby: 妹[いもうと]の絵[え]は子供[こども]としちゃ、色[いろ]の使[つか]い方[かた]がうまい。
examples.english: For a kid, my little sister uses color awfully well in that picture.
